note: Free FCFS USFS campground at ~10,900 ft beside Little Molas Lake, reached by ~1 mi of dirt road (FR 584) off US-550 just north of Molas Pass; road is washboarded but 2WD/passenger-car passable. 10 sites, 5 of which fit RVs. Pit toilets, no water, no hookups; 14-day limit, not on recreation.gov. --Claude
summary: No agency page states this campground's facts, so nothing written; all stored values unconfirmed but uncontradicted. Free FCFS campground with about 10 sites (third-party), reached by FR 584 (FS road table: open 6/1-11/30).
flags: No FS campground page exists: Little Molas Lake is not among the 30 campgrounds on San Juan NF's camping-cabins list or in the Southwestern Colorado Campground Guide (media/241238), and slugs little-molas-lake(-campground) return 404. The only agency mentions are the forest road table ('Little Molas Lake 6/1 11/30', the access-road season) and the Twin Sisters Trail page (FR 584 'dead ends at a large parking area and trailhead'). Designated sites vs dispersed area cannot be settled from an agency source; Campendium (report 9/9/2025) lists 10 sites with gravel pads.
Website: the stored https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/sanjuan/recreation/camping-cabins doesn't mention the campground. No campground-specific FS page to replace it with.
Missing phone: Columbine Ranger District 970-884-2512 (the Twin Sisters Trail page at FR 584's end names 'Recreation Region: Columbine Ranger District').

Rig fit (no agency length): Campendium's longest reported rig is a 43-ft fifth wheel (reported 9/9/2025); older reviews say only about three sites fit a 30-ft fifth wheel, while a 34-ft fifth wheel found several.

Road: no FS RV or 4WD wording for FR 584; the road table gives a 6/1-11/30 season and no damage note (neighbouring Lime Creek Rd 591 is partly closed from the Oct 2025 flood). Third-party: passable by 2WD passenger cars, washboarded.
Waterfront (stored lakeview) stands: on imagery the pin is on the camp loop ~200 m north of the lake, and the pull-off sites along the loop sit on a wooded slope ~150-250 m above the shore.
Pin 37.74513,-107.70815 is on the campground loop (no recreation.gov catalog to compare). OK.
